description: This file defines structures and function prototypes related to 'loose object' mapping within a version control system, likely Git. It includes declarations for managing mappings between object IDs and their storage or compatibility counterparts, along with functions for initialization, clearing, reading, writing, and adding to these maps.

methods.name: loose_object_map_clear
methods.description: Clears and deallocates resources associated with a loose_object_map.

methods.name: repo_loose_object_map_oid
methods.description: Finds the map for a given object ID and converts it to a compatible object ID using specified algorithms.

methods.name: repo_add_loose_object_map
methods.description: Adds a mapping from an object ID to a compatible object ID in the context of a repository source.

methods.name: repo_read_loose_object_map
methods.description: Reads the loose object map for a repository from storage.

methods.name: repo_write_loose_object_map
methods.description: Writes the current loose object map of a repository to storage.
